#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded real-CLI watch conversion/source-boundary observation; never builds Mantle."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def digest(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["b3sum", "--no-names", str(path)], text=True).strip()


def atomic_write(path, text):
    next_path = path.with_suffix(".next")
    next_path.write_text(text)
    next_path.replace(path)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--mantle", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--scratch", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    binary = args.mantle.resolve(strict=True)
    scratch = args.scratch.absolute()
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    store = scratch / "store"
    store.mkdir()
    library = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "lib/lib.ncl"
    require(library.is_file(), f"missing repository library: {library}")
    source = scratch / "root.ncl"
    valid = (f"let mantle = import {json.dumps(str(library))} in\n"
             '{ name = "watch-conversion-retained", builder = "/bin/sh", '
             'args = ["-c", "printf retained > \\\"$out\\\"" ] } | mantle.Derivation\n')
    invalid_input = "/wrong/store/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa-source"
    conversion_failure = (f"let mantle = import {json.dumps(str(library))} in\n"
                          '{ name = "watch-conversion-rejected", builder = "/bin/sh", '
                          'args = ["-c", "exit 99"], inputs = [' + json.dumps(invalid_input)
                          + '] } | mantle.Derivation\n')
    # The invalid candidate is Nickel-contract-valid but cannot convert under
    # the selected /mantle/store prefix. Calibrate both sides before watching.
    candidate = scratch / "conversion.ncl"
    candidate.write_text(conversion_failure)
    result = {"schema": "mantle-watch-error-retention-observation-v1", "status": "failed",
              "executable": str(binary), "before_blake3": digest(binary), "commands": []}

    def run(label, argv):
        started = time.time()
        command = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        (scratch / f"{label}.stdout").write_text(command.stdout)
        (scratch / f"{label}.stderr").write_text(command.stderr)
        result["commands"].append({"label": label, "argv": argv, "exit_code": command.returncode,
                                   "started_unix": started, "finished_unix": time.time(),
                                   "stdout": command.stdout, "stderr": command.stderr})
        return command

    evaluation = run("nickel-valid-candidate", [str(binary), "eval", str(candidate)])
    require(evaluation.returncode == 0, "conversion candidate failed Nickel evaluation")
    planning = run("conversion-rejected-candidate", [str(binary), "build", "--plan", str(candidate)])
    require(planning.returncode != 0 and "invalid store path" in planning.stderr.lower(),
            "candidate did not specifically fail derivation conversion")
    atomic_write(source, valid)
    command = [str(binary), "--store", str(store), "--state-dir", str(scratch / "state"),
               "build", "--watch", str(source), "--no-substitute", "--jobs", "1"]
    result["watch_argv"] = command
    stdout = scratch / "watch.stdout"
    stderr = scratch / "watch.stderr"
    with stdout.open("wb") as output, stderr.open("wb") as errors:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=output, stderr=errors)
        try:
            def wait_for(predicate, message):
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
                while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    require(process.poll() is None, f"watch exited {process.returncode}: see {stderr}")
                    value = predicate()
                    if value:
                        return value
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                raise RuntimeError(message)

            def log():
                return stdout.read_text()

            def settled(offset):
                return re.search(r"generation \d+: settled 1 successful, 0 failed root\(s\)", log()[offset:])

            wait_for(lambda: settled(0), "initial root did not settle")
            outputs = list(store.glob("*-watch-conversion-retained"))
            require(len(outputs) == 1, f"wrong initial output set: {outputs}")
            artifact = outputs[0]

            def retained_identity():
                metadata = artifact.stat()
                return {"path": str(artifact), "inode": metadata.st_ino, "mtime_ns": metadata.st_mtime_ns,
                        "bytes": artifact.read_text(), "blake3": digest(artifact)}

            baseline = retained_identity()
            require(baseline["bytes"] == "retained", "initial output bytes differ")
            offset = len(log())
            atomic_write(source, conversion_failure)
            wait_for(lambda: "edit rejected:" in log()[offset:], "conversion failure was not reported")
            rejected = log()[offset:]
            require("  retracted " not in rejected and "  added " not in rejected,
                    "conversion failure changed the admitted roots")
            require(retained_identity() == baseline, "conversion failure changed the retained output")
            require(not list(store.glob("*-watch-conversion-rejected")), "rejected candidate produced output")
            result["conversion_rejection"] = rejected
            offset = len(log())
            atomic_write(source, valid)
            wait_for(lambda: settled(offset), "valid roots did not recover after conversion failure")
            recovered = log()[offset:]
            require("  retained " in recovered and "  added " not in recovered and "  retracted " not in recovered,
                    "conversion recovery did not retain the admitted identity")
            require(retained_identity() == baseline, "conversion recovery rebuilt the retained output")
            result["conversion_recovery"] = recovered
            offset = len(log())
            atomic_write(source, "#" + "x" * 2_097_152 + "\n" + valid)
            wait_for(lambda: "edit rejected:" in log()[offset:], "oversized watched source was not rejected")
            oversized = log()[offset:]
            require("  retracted " not in oversized and "  added " not in oversized,
                    "source-byte rejection changed the admitted roots")
            require(retained_identity() == baseline, "oversized source changed the retained output")
            result["source_byte_rejection"] = oversized
            offset = len(log())
            atomic_write(source, valid)
            wait_for(lambda: settled(offset), "valid roots did not recover after source-byte rejection")
            require(retained_identity() == baseline, "source-byte recovery rebuilt the retained output")
            result.update(status="passed", retained=baseline, source_byte_recovery=log()[offset:],
                          assertions=["Nickel-valid conversion failure", "reported conversion rejection",
                                      "no admitted-set mutation", "retained inode/mtime/bytes",
                                      "conversion recovery", "source-byte-bound retention", "source-byte recovery"])
        except Exception as error:
            result["error"] = str(error)
            raise
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=30)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    result.update(status="failed", pending_teardown_pid=process.pid,
                                  error="watch retains pending teardown after SIGTERM; not force-killed")
            result["watch_exit_code"] = process.poll()
            if process.returncode not in (None, 0):
                result.update(status="failed", error=f"watch shutdown exited {process.returncode}")
            result["after_blake3"] = digest(binary)
            require(result["before_blake3"] == result["after_blake3"], "immutable executable drifted")
            (scratch / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    require(result["status"] == "passed", result.get("error", "watch boundary observation failed"))
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
